newsitem.title: UK: BTG,Osteonics sign hip cup patent agreement.
newsitem.headline: BTG,Osteonics sign hip cup patent agreement.

text.p: British technology company BTG Plc said on Thursday it had signed a licence agreement with Osteonics and its parent Stryker Corp for two-part hip cup patents, an invention used in hip joint replacements.
Osteonics manufactures a range of hip joint replacements worldwide and has a 10 percent share of the market. The U.S. market for hip joint prostheses is around $750 million a year.

The patents had been subject to an interference in the U.S. between BTG and Johnson & Johnson to determine who was entitled to the patent, but this has been resolved by arbitration. Now BTG has the right to licence both BTG and J&J patents to the industry, the group said.
"The arbitration with J&J over the patent interference removed uncertainty within the orthopaedics industry to rights under these patents," said Ian Harvey, BTG's chief executive.
BTG is in licence negotiations with several other companies.
